スマブラでは、背中も技表の一部である

Cross-ups matter in traditional fighting games too. The more interesting difference is that Smash often keeps facing direction as a persistent game state. Fair and Bair are different moves, out-of-shield answers change by side, and RAR exists to separate movement direction from facing. This essay reframes Smash as not only a game of distance, but a game of editing orientation.
